content.text:
Any engineer on the **Growth team** can sign off. The Growth team has owned the notifier since 2026-09-01. Template and copy changes get approved in **#growth-eng**.

You may see older notes saying Dana Okafor has to approve notifier copy changes. That's out of date: she moved to Platform, and the project memory store already marks that note as replaced by the current one. I didn't find a CODEOWNERS file in the repo, so this comes from the team's shared project notes, not from anything enforced in code.

When you make the change, the template rules for the notifier say:
- The receipt email lives in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`.
- It has a plain-text copy, `<event>.txt`, that needs the same wording change. Some corporate mail systems remove the HTML version, so those readers only see the plain text.
- Template variables use snake_case.
